svg.title: Lasutriv — Royal Charter banner
svg.desc: Lasutriv. ROLE: Game developer · autonomous AI agents. LATEST: Monarchy · New Roots. ASSET: AIA-Evolve, an AI agent that ships code 24/7. An illuminated charter on vellum with a gold-leaf name, vines growing from the initial and a wax seal over crossed pennants.

g.text: AIA-Evolve, an AI agent that ships code 24/7
